title: Exposure Programmer Art
description: Makes the Exposure mod fit in with the Programmer Art style
body:
This resource pack was created primarily to make it fit in with mods like Wonderland.jar that use the programmer art style. In case you ever feel like documenting scary stuff this is the perfect way to feel fully immersed in the world. This changes both the items and blocks of the mod.

Or you could just use it normally with any programmer art pack its up to you :P
